name: Experiment 4 supplemental sensitivity analyses
status: analysis definitions fixed before supplemental result computation

common_pair_analysis.population: intersection of pairs estimable at all three primary landmarks
common_pair_analysis.seed_alignment: retain only pair-seed combinations estimable at all three landmarks in both models
common_pair_analysis.aggregation: average retained seeds within each pair/day/model, then equal-weight pairs
common_pair_analysis.uncertainty: 2000 joint resamples of provider plus base-course clusters, preserving all pairs and days in sampled clusters
common_pair_analysis.interpretation: associational temporal pattern within supported pair-seeds, not a causal effect of observation time

unique_user_course_analysis.assignment: among eligible base courses a username entered, keep the base course of their earliest observed enrollment event; break ties lexicographically by provider and base-course token
unique_user_course_analysis.population: original primary target-active-unseen predictions at days 7, 14, 28, filtered to usernames assigned to that pair's base course
unique_user_course_analysis.models_and_calibrators: use saved frozen primary predictions; no base-model or calibrator refitting
unique_user_course_analysis.aggregation: average seeds within pair/day/model, then equal-weight pairs on the original support units
unique_user_course_analysis.uncertainty: 2000 joint resamples of provider plus base-course clusters, comparing restricted and original outcomes in each resample
unique_user_course_analysis.minimum_retained_support: no post hoc exclusion; report count below original target N>=50 and each class>=10 thresholds
unique_user_course_analysis.interpretation: conditional evaluation-level student deduplication; does not remove shared training or calibration users across courses
